ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform for local artisans of Odisha to generate trustworthy product listings, verify authentic handloom provenance via image analysis, and streamline digital sales.
ideas.title: OdishaCraft AI-Commerce & Cultural Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with regional pride at NIT Rourkela and utilizes the Fueler Digital Bundle by creating a highly polished creator-facing workflow that can be immediately marketed.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting and incident-reporting dashboard designed for university campuses in Eastern India to predict crowding bottlenecks and safety risks using spatial-temporal data.
ideas.title: CampusPulse Real-time Student Incident & Safety Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the hackathon organizers and university student judges feel directly on their own campus.

ideas.pitch: An AI dietary assistant tailored to traditional Eastern Indian cuisine that provides personalized nutritional insights and affordable meal recommendations using local ingredients.
ideas.title: SwasthyaSahayak Regional Nutritional & Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear local relevance and practical consumer utility, fitting the criteria for the Fueler Digital Bundle.

ideas.pitch: An automated logistics app connecting elderly residents in regional towns with verified student volunteer drivers for medical and social outings.
ideas.title: Sahyog Community Volunteer & Senior Ride Co-Op
ideas.why_it_could_win: Offers a clear, quantifiable social impact metric that resonates strongly with judges looking for real-world community benefit.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite and compliance monitoring dashboard designed to track environmental and zoning regulations for industrial plants in Odisha.
ideas.title: GridGuardian Industrial Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a complex domain-specific industrial monitoring problem relevant to the mineral-rich Eastern Indian belt.
